source.pointer: Latest user: do not implement the large plan; first think through a small future-30-minute prediction MVP for rapid validation

goalContract.outcome: Design a small, testable M30 extension without implementing the full holdings assistant or business changes in this turn

mustAccept.statement: Keep this turn design-only and scope much smaller than the full assistant

verification.statement: Inspect MVP scope and actual document-only write actions

mustAccept.statement: Define future-30-minute output, fixed timing and legacy compatibility

verification.statement: Inspect existing scheduler, forecast parser and frozen projection; map to the proposed extension

mustAccept.statement: Provide a quick evaluation loop with all opportunity and quality states

verification.statement: Inspect endpoint protocol, timing, baselines and research snapshot design

constraints: No business-code, business-DB or runtime changes this turn
Preserve dirty work and old frozen tasks
Do not treat delayed next analysis as fixed M30 endpoint
preferences: Reuse existing stack and raw replies
No new business schema for first experiment
assumptions: A future versioned optional root extension can coexist with the existing base contract, subject to tests
unknowns: Live source freshness and minute timestamp/completion
Actual deployed task cadence and latency

evidence.statement: Technical scheduler default is a 30-minute fixedDelay; DAY currently requires T1/T5 and old horizon parser excludes M30
Task preparation freezes request JSON; raw replies persist and public v6 output is rendered rather than raw text
evidence.freshness: Current relevant source inspected, not runtime proof

evidence.statement: Minute interface exists but nonnull validity and inferred end time do not prove completed qualified endpoints
MVP draft specifies one same-call extension, existing reply storage, no new business tables, fixed windows, abstention and readonly evaluation
evidence.freshness: Current design draft inspected; not implemented

claims.statement: Analysis cadence and a future M30 forecast are distinct; appending M30 to the old daily forecast array is not a safe minimal path
falsifiers: A deployed independent parser already handles M30 under a verified contract

claims.statement: An optional frozen extension and readonly research script are a smaller candidate path than new holdings, delivery and schema infrastructure
hiddenAssumptions: Only new eligible tasks receive the profile
Malformed M30 does not invalidate otherwise valid legacy results
Endpoint semantics and reference quote freshness are qualified before scoring
falsifiers: Required data or timing cannot support a fixed endpoint
Legacy replay or publication regressions appear
alternativesConsidered: One new intraday DB table and automated evaluation
No-schema optional extension plus manual readonly scoring

conclusion.statement: A no-new-business-schema same-call M30 experiment is a scoped design candidate for discussion; implementation and effectiveness remain unproven
remainingBoundaries: No verified live source or deployed cadence
Engineering trial defaults are proposed, not proven
